description: Cluster job script and test-suite wiring (design 9, AC 6): slurm/predict_mindboggle.sh, its static checks in tests/test_slurm_scripts.py, and the new files in tests/run_tests_wsl.sh (py3.8 PYFILES list, bash -n list, TF-free test list). Independent of FEAT-002..004 code except for the predict.py CLI flags it calls (FEAT-004). Does NOT submit anything.
steps: Create slurm/predict_mindboggle.sh following slurm/eval_mindboggle.sh: header `#SBATCH --job-name=bgr-predict`, `-A qtim`, `-p rtx8000`, `--gpus=1`, `-N 1`, `--ntasks-per-node=1`, `--cpus-per-task=3`, `--mem=96G`, `--time=05:00:00`, `--output=$PROJ/logs/%x-%j.out`, `--error=$PROJ/logs/%x-%j.err` (absolute /autofs/space/crater_001/users/jn85/BrainRegProjects/GroupwiseReg/logs paths). Header comment: DO NOT submit without Jay's approval; env overrides CKPT (default $PROJ/results/m9_level1_cascade/ckpt/best_deform), NAME (m9_best_deform_5000_deform), BRANCHES (deform), PROCESSED ($PROJ/data/processed/mindboggle), OUT ($PROJ/results/predict_mindboggle/$NAME), N_CHECK (4), CHECK_CHUNKS ('--chunk-l4 3 --chunk-l2 3 --chunk-l1 3'), GRID_REF ($PROJ/data/target_grid/target_grid.json), EVAL_PAIRS (none), EXTRA; the OOM fallback for step 1a (N_CHECK=3 CHECK_CHUNKS='--chunk-l4 2 --chunk-l2 2 --chunk-l1 2'); and the review NIT 2 sentence: on exit 4 read check_streaming_f32.json; localised differences or differences growing with field magnitude point to an engine bug (fix the code); uniform differences slightly above the bound point to rounding: resubmit with --tol-* overrides chosen from the measured numbers and record them in the report; never drop the gate.

Script body (set -uo pipefail; TMPDIR=/scratch/$SLURM_JOB_ID; every container call `singularity exec --nv -B /autofs -B /scratch "$SIF" bash -c 'cd "$1" && shift && python "$@"' predict "$REPO" ... </dev/null`; print host, job id, `git -C "$REPO" log --oneline -1`; mkdir -p "$OUT"): 1a `predict.py check-streaming --checkpoint "$CKPT" --processed-dir "$PROCESSED" --grid-reference "$GRID_REF" --precision float32 --n-subjects "$N_CHECK" $CHECK_CHUNKS --branches "$BRANCHES" --out "$OUT/check_streaming_f32.json" || exit $?` ($CHECK_CHUNKS unquoted on purpose, with a comment); 1b same with `--precision checkpoint --out "$OUT/check_streaming_fp16.json" || echo "WARNING: fp16 streaming check rc $? (non-blocking), see $OUT/check_streaming_fp16.json"`; 1c step-1a command with `--branches affine+deform --out "$OUT/check_streaming_affine_deform_f32.json" || echo "WARNING: affine+deform streaming check rc $? (non-blocking) ..."`; 2 `predict.py run --checkpoint "$CKPT" --processed-dir "$PROCESSED" --grid-reference "$GRID_REF" --branches "$BRANCHES" --out "$OUT/fields" $EXTRA || exit $?`; 3 `python -m evaluation check-convention --processed-dir "$PROCESSED" --fwd "$OUT/fields/{subject_dir}_fwd.nii.gz" --inv "$OUT/fields/{subject_dir}_inv.nii.gz" --moved "$OUT/fields/{subject_dir}_moved.nii.gz" --out "$OUT/convention.json"` (read evaluation/evaluate.py build_parser for the exact check-convention / run flag names) then `python -m evaluation run --processed-dir "$PROCESSED" --method "$NAME" --fwd ... --inv ... --atlas "$OUT/fields/atlas.nii.gz" --atlas-seg "$OUT/fields/atlas_seg.nii.gz" --components xyz --signs +++ --units mm --pairs "$EVAL_PAIRS" --workers 3 --out "$OUT/eval_template"`; finally echo the separate basic-partition command `METHOD=$NAME FWD=... INV=... ATLAS=... ATLAS_SEG=... CONV="--components xyz --signs +++ --units mm" sbatch slurm/eval_mindboggle.sh` (printed, never run). No `sbatch` invocation inside the script. ASCII only, LF line endings.

tests/test_slurm_scripts.py: add PREDICT = os.path.join(REPO, 'slurm', 'predict_mindboggle.sh') and a TestStatic test: header values (--time=05:00:00, --mem=96G, --cpus-per-task=3, --gpus=1, -A qtim, -p rtx8000, logs under the project logs dir), `</dev/null` on every singularity line, no line starting with sbatch (the printed eval command is inside echo), step 1a has --precision float32 and ends with `|| exit $?`, steps 1b / 1c end in `|| echo "WARNING`, CHECK_CHUNKS default '--chunk-l4 3 --chunk-l2 3 --chunk-l1 3' and `$CHECK_CHUNKS` on all three check-streaming lines, `--grid-reference "$GRID_REF"` on every predict.py call, BRANCHES default deform, ASCII only, no '\r'. Add PREDICT to test_bash_syntax. Keep the module stdlib-only.

tests/run_tests_wsl.sh: append `predict.py inference/*.py evaluation/*.py` to PYFILES (stage-1 py_compile + ast 3.8 check); add slurm/predict_mindboggle.sh and slurm/eval_mindboggle.sh to the `bash -n` loop; add tests.test_predict_store to the TF-free test list (names = [...]).
Run the stage-1 checks and the TF-free tests; commit locally on main ('predict-script FEAT-005: slurm/predict_mindboggle.sh + suite wiring'). Never push, never sbatch.

findings: Done. slurm/predict_mindboggle.sh (LF, ASCII): header per design 9 (bgr-predict, qtim, rtx8000, 1 GPU, 3 CPU, 96G, 05:00:00, logs under $PROJ/logs), env overrides CKPT/NAME/BRANCHES/PROCESSED/OUT/N_CHECK/CHECK_CHUNKS/GRID_REF/EVAL_PAIRS/EXTRA (+ REPO/SIF like eval_mindboggle.sh), OOM fallback and exit-4 (review NIT 2) text in the header.
